derivations.method: STA printed '02:31+1'; the '+1' was resolved to the calendar day after the row date (11/09) before conversion from LHR-arrival station MAD local time. Off Duty '03:01+1' resolved the same way.

STD printed '00:00+1', i.e. 16/09 00:00 MAD local, even though the row is dated 15/09; the whole duty (report 23:00 on 15/09 through Off Duty 09:10+1) was anchored to the 15/09 report and rolled forward from there.
DUB arrival printed '00:41+1' and the following DUB departure '01:31+1' resolved to 20/09 local Dublin time; Off Duty '05:41+1' to 20/09 MAD local.
MAD arrival printed '00:26+1' and Off Duty '00:56+1' resolved to 28/09 MAD local, which converts back to 27/09 in UTC (UTC+2).

Duty end taken from the printed 'Off Duty' column on the last row of each duty (local at the final arrival station, always MAD here). Applied identically to every flight duty; not derived from an offset. Report times are printed in the Report column, so no reporting offset was assumed anywhere.
